title: ReviewRoiView
description: Observed review activity, finding outcomes and measured reviewer costs. Estimating causal return requires a labeled comparison sample.

completed_agent_reviews.description: Completed review records with an agent reviewer.

completed_human_reviews.description: Completed review records with a human reviewer.

unique_findings.description: Distinct finding keys per task across completed reviews.

resolved_findings.description: Distinct findings whose latest record is resolved.

rejected_findings.description: Distinct findings whose latest record is rejected.

finished_reviewer_steps.description: Terminal reviewer steps, including failed and cancelled invocations.

priced_reviewer_steps.description: Terminal reviewer steps with reported usage and a computed catalog price.

timed_reviewer_steps.description: Terminal reviewer steps with a recorded monotonic capture duration.

observed_cost_usd.description: Sum of USD cost for priced steps, or null when no step is priced.

observed_duration_ms.description: Sum of capture durations for timed steps, or null when none is timed.
